title: InferenceRequest
description: Exhaustive JSON Schema for InferenceRequest payload contract verified against origin/engine mofa-kernel/src/types.rs.

capability.description: Target capability to invoke. Null defaults to 'chat'.

model.description: Canonical 'provider/model' ID or unique short model name. Null triggers deterministic auto-routing.

app_id.description: Application scope identifier (e.g. 'mofa-fm') used by Markov preflight predictor.

session_id.description: Session correlation identifier for multi-turn inference tracking.

fallback_policy.description: Fallback routing behavior strategy. 'capability_only' stays within target capability; 'disabled' prevents fallback.

locality.description: Routing locality guardrail. 'local_only' restricts to local hardware for privacy; 'prefer_local' ranks local ahead of cloud.

data_class.description: Data privacy classification tier. 'confidential' strictly blocks cloud fallback.

reasoning.description: Deep reasoning configuration for models like DeepSeek R1.

include.description: Whether to return reasoning thought tokens in response.

content.example: Write a 30-second podcast script about quantum computing.

input_file.description: Absolute path to input audio/video/image file on engine host (for ASR, VLM, document processing).

params.description: Extra provider pass-through parameters (e.g. voice, speed, temperature, max_tokens).

hint_next.description: Next anticipated capability (e.g. 'tts') for cross-capability preflight warming.

request_id.description: Unique correlation request ID. Auto-generated by engine if omitted.
